reviews.explanation: The target proposal is 薛瑩, the author of the 後漢書 (Later Han History) cited in the Liu Xiaobiao annotation. Candidate c0 is 薛瑩, which is the same person as the target. Candidate c4 is also 薛瑩 from the prior candidate registry, referring to the same person. Candidates c1 (元禮), c2 (李元禮), and c3 (李膺) all refer to Li Ying (李膺), the subject of the annotation, not to Xue Ying (薛瑩) the citation author. The annotation text '薛瑩後漢書曰李膺字元禮' clearly distinguishes Xue Ying as the author of the cited work from Li Ying who is the person being described.

The target proposal is 陳紀 (陳元方), the father of 長文 (陳羣) and brother of 季方. The main text refers to 陳元方, and the Liu annotation identifies 陳羣 as 字長文, son of 元方. The proposal identifies the referent as 陳紀. Candidate c0 (陳紀) is the same person as the proposed target. Candidate c1 (元方) is the courtesy name of 陳紀, thus same person. Candidate c8 (陳元方) is the full surface form of the same person. Candidate c2 (孝先) is the courtesy name of 忠, son of 諶 (季方's son), thus a different person (nephew). Candidate c3 (季方) is 陳紀's brother, thus related_person. Candidate c4 (忠) is 孝先's actual name, son of 諶, different person. Candidate c5 (諶) is 季方's name, different person. Candidate c6 (長文) is 陳羣, son of 陳紀, thus kinship_relation. Candidate c7 (陳羣) is 陳紀's son, thus kinship_relation.

The target is 阮嗣宗 (courtesy name of 阮籍). Candidate c0 is 阮籍, explicitly identified in the annotation as 阮籍字嗣宗, making it the same person. Candidate c1 (子上) is the courtesy name of 司馬昭 (文王), a different person. Candidate c2 (昭) refers to 司馬昭, also different. Candidate c3 (李康) and c4 (王昶) are other historical figures mentioned in the annotations, different persons. Candidate c5 (阮瑀) is 阮籍's father (阮瑀子 = son of 阮瑀), making it a kinship relation, not identity.

The target is 袁府君 (Governor Yuan), who appears in the main text as the official who immediately set out to campaign against 孫恩's rebellion. Candidate c0 is the same surface form 袁府君 from the same main text evidence, so it is the same person. All other candidates refer to different individuals: c1 (孫恩) is the rebel leader being fought against; c2 (山松) is a person mentioned in annotation; c3 (恩) and c4 (泰) are parts of the 孫恩/孫泰 annotation; c5 (辛昺) is the 臨海太守 who beheaded 孫恩; c6 (遺) and c7 (陳遺) are the filial protagonist 陳遺, a different person from 袁府君.

The target proposal is 陳寔 (Chen Shi), and the mention '太丘長' refers to the office title held by Chen Shi. The main text identifies 陳仲弓 (Chen Zhonggong) as 太丘長, and the Liu annotation glosses 寔/陳, confirming that 陳寔 is the person. All candidates (陳寔, 仲弓, 寔, 陳仲弓) refer to the same historical person, Chen Shi (陳寔), whose courtesy name was 仲弓. The annotation explicitly equates 寔 with 陳, and the main text uses 陳仲弓 and 仲弓 interchangeably for the same person holding the office of 太丘長.

The target is 王藍田 (Wang Lantian), which refers to 王述 (Wang Shu), who held the title 藍田侯 (Marquis of Lantian). The Liu annotation evidence sfh1-ev-04-wenxue-022-liu-annotation-002 identifies 王述 with the courtesy name 懷祖, and sfh1-ev-04-wenxue-022-liu-annotation-003 states he inherited the title 藍田侯. Candidates c0, c6 (懷祖, his courtesy name), c8, and c9 (述, his given name) all refer to the same person 王述. Candidates c1 (庾亮), c5 (亮), c7 (浩) are different people mentioned in the annotation. c2 (王導) and c3 (王濛) are related people mentioned alongside 王述 in the annotation but are distinct individuals. c4 (謝尚) is another person present at the gathering in the main text.

The target proposal is 法汰 (法汰法師), referenced in the main text as 汰法師. Candidate c0 is the LLM entity proposal for 法汰, directly matching the target. Candidate c1 is the same person 法汰 retrieved from validated local person mentions, with the same annotation evidence identifying 法汰. Candidate c2 is 汰法師, which is the surface form of the target mention itself (汰法師 = 法汰法師), referring to the same person. All three candidates refer to the same historical figure 法汰 (竺法汰), a Buddhist monk mentioned in the Shishuo xinyu entry.

The target mention '滔' refers to 伏滔 (Fu Tao), who appears in the Liu annotation text as '滔宻以啓温' and is explicitly identified as '時伏滔在温府'. Candidate c0 is 伏滔, the same person. Candidate c1 (桓溫) is the person 滔 reports to (温), a related person. Candidate c2 (温嶠) is a different person from 桓溫. Candidate c3 (袁宏) is the main subject of the story, related to 滔 as a colleague/contemporary. Candidate c4 (宏) refers to 袁宏, related. Candidates c5-c8 (山, 範, 胡奴, 胡奴陶) are different persons from 伏滔.

The target mention is 鍾士季 (Zhong Shiji), which is the courtesy name of 鍾會 (Zhong Hui). The main text explicitly identifies 鍾士季 as the person being visited, and the Liu annotation confirms 鍾會. Candidate c0 is 鍾會, which is the same person as the target. Candidate c5 is also 鍾會 (same person). Candidate c6 is 鍾士季, which is the exact surface form of the target mention, thus the same person. Candidates c1 (王戎), c2 (戎), c3 (裴叔則), and c4 (裴楷) are different people mentioned in the same passage.

The target is 劉粹 (Liu Cui), one of the three '嘏' brothers mentioned in the main text. Candidate c0 is 劉粹, the same person as the target. Candidate c14 is 粹, which is the shortened form of the same name 劉粹, referring to the same person. Candidate c21 is also 劉粹 from prior candidate observation, same person. Candidate c5 (宏) and c11 (漠) are 劉粹's brothers (kinship). Candidate c13 (王安豐) is their uncle (kinship). Candidate c15 (純嘏) is 劉粹's courtesy name (attribute_of). All other candidates are different people mentioned in the same passage.

The target is 宋明帝 (Emperor Ming of Song), which appears in the Liu Xiaobiao annotation as the author of 文章志. Candidate c0 is also 宋明帝, the same person. The other candidates (桓溫, 王濛, 劉恢, 劉道生, 庾稺恭, 明濟) are all different historical figures mentioned in the same passage or annotation, but none of them is 宋明帝 himself.

The target mention is 周伯仁 (courtesy name of 周顗). Candidate c0 is 周顗, which is the same person — the main text explicitly states 周顗比臣有國士門風, and the Liu annotation identifies 伯仁 as 周顗. Candidate c1 (郗鑒) is a different person mentioned in the same passage as a comparison subject. Candidate c2 (鄧粲) is the author of the cited work 晉紀 in the annotation, not the target person. Candidate c3 (鑒) is a shortened reference to 郗鑒, a different person.

The target mention is 温太真 (Wen Taizhen), which is the courtesy name (字) of 温嶠 (Wen Qiao). The main text refers to 温太真, and the Liu annotation provides genealogical context about the 温 clan. The candidate c0 is 温嶠, the same historical person whose courtesy name is 太真. The main text explicitly discusses 温太真 as a person of the 過江 second rank, and 温嶠 is the well-known historical figure with this courtesy name. The annotations confirm the 温 surname lineage. This is the same person.

The target mention is 阮思曠 (Ruan Sikuang), which is the courtesy name (字) of 阮裕 (Ruan Yu). Candidate c0 is 阮裕, the proposed target person, and candidate c8 is 阮思曠, the surface form of the same person. Both refer to the same historical figure. The other candidates (桓温, 王濛, 謝尚, 劉眞長, 孫興公, 殷洪逺, 袁羊) are all distinct individuals mentioned in the same passage as separate people being evaluated by 孫興公.

The target mention is '吾' (I) spoken by 魏武 (Cao Cao) in the main text. Candidate c0 is 曹操 (Cao Cao), who is the same person as 魏武. All other candidates are different historical persons mentioned in the text or annotations: 娥/曹娥/孝女曹娥 are the filial daughter, 楊脩/脩 is Yang Xiu, 盱 is Cao E's father, 禰正平/衡 is Mi Heng, 邯鄲子禮 is Handan Zili, and 陳留蔡邕 is Cai Yong. None of these are the same person as Cao Cao.

The target mention is 嵇叔夜 (style name of 嵇康), and the main text explicitly states 嵇康身長七尺八寸...山公曰嵇叔夜之為人也, confirming that 嵇叔夜 refers to 嵇康. Candidate c0 is the canonical person 嵇康, which is the same person. Candidate c1 is 康, which appears in the Liu annotation quoting 康别傳曰康長七尺, referring to the same person 嵇康 (shortened form of his given name). Both candidates refer to the same historical person as the target.

The target mention is 茂弘, which is the courtesy name of 王導 (Wang Dao). The main text says 王丞相 (Wang Dao as Chancellor) tried to recruit 李廞, and 廞 responds '茂弘乃復以一爵假人' — 茂弘 is Wang Dao's courtesy name. Candidate c0 is 王導, the same person. Candidate c4 is 導, which is a shortened form of 王導's given name, also referring to the same person. All other candidates (李重, 史, 宗子, 廞, 式, 景則, 李廞) are different people mentioned in the text or annotations — they are the Li family members or other figures, not 王導.

The target mention '康' refers to 嵇康 (Ji Kang), as the text lists 嵇康 among the Seven Worthies of the Bamboo Grove and then refers to him by the shortened name '康'. Candidate c0 is 嵇康 himself, making it the same person. All other candidates (劉伶, 向秀, 山濤, 王戎, 阮籍, 阮咸) are distinct individuals who are fellow members of the Seven Worthies but not the same person as 嵇康.

The target mention is 劉道真 in the main text. The liu_annotation explicitly identifies this person as 劉寳 (已見/劉寳), confirming the canonical name. Candidate c0 is 劉寶 (variant of 劉寳), c1 is 劉寳, and c2 is 道真 (the given name used in the text for the same person). All three candidates refer to the same historical person as the target proposal 劉寶.

The target mention '卿' refers to 温嶠 (温太真), who is the person being addressed in the story. Candidate c0 is 温嶠 himself, the same person as the proposed target. Candidate c1 is 庾亮, who is a different person in the narrative (the one being called upon to redeem 温嶠). Candidate c2 is '嶠' from the Liu annotation, which refers to the same person 温嶠.

The target proposal is 劉驎之 (also known as 劉遺民). Candidate c0 is 劉驎之, the same person as the proposed target. Candidate c2 is also 劉驎之, the same person. Candidates c1 (謝安), c3 (張玄), and c4 (王文度) are other people mentioned in the same passage but are distinct from the target.

The target mention is '嘏' in the Liu annotation, referring to 傅嘏 (Fu Gu). The annotation text '傅嘏往喭粲' shows 傅嘏 visiting 粲 (荀粲). Candidates c0 and c3 both display name 傅嘏 and are the same person as the target. Candidate c9 is '嘏' which is the same surface form as the target mention and refers to the same person 傅嘏. Candidates c1 (仲尼/Confucius), c2 (何劭), c4 (奉倩/荀奉倩), c5 (曹洪), c6 (粲/荀粲), c7 (荀奉倩), c8 (荀粲) are all different people mentioned in the same passage but not the target 傅嘏.
